entry.summary:
The Tairua-Pāuanui Community Board met on the 10 November 2025 , here is the recording of that meeting. 

1. MEETING CONDUCT | NGĀ WHANONGA-Ā-HUI      
0:00:00 - 1.1 Welcome/Karakia, 1.2 Apologies/Attendance, 1.3 Conflict of Interest
0:01:31 - 1.4 Making and Attesting of Members' Declarations 
0:04:03 - 1.5 Election of Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson
0:09:05 - 1.6 Public Forum
2. INFORMATION ONLY REPORTS | HE PĀRONGO PŪRONGO NOA      
0:14:09 - 2.1 General Explanation of Statutory Requirements for Elected Members 2025
0:19:30 - 2.2 Close of Meeting/Karakia
